about.title: About Me
about.name: Taito Amemiya
about.p1: With a 10-year career as an IT engineer, I currently lead projects and teams. I tackle business challenges across a wide range of technological domains, from requirements definition to implementation and AI utilization.
about.p2: At the same time, I am a bassist and keyboardist, running a sole proprietorship for music production, music engraving, and score publishing (Piascore).
about.p3: "Logical Engineering" and "Expressive Music". By crossing these seemingly distinct worlds and mutually leveraging their insights, I continue to create unique value.
